description:
## Features

Merged [anddea/revanced-patches](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches) `dev` (4.4.0-dev.2) into the fork.

Where both repositories carried the same feature ported from [Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches), anddea's implementation replaces this fork's copy. The settings of these features reset to their defaults after updating:

### YouTube
- **Disable auto feed refresh:** unchanged behaviour, now anddea's implementation.
- **Picture-in-picture button:** replaces the PiP overlay button. Settings: RVX → Player → Player buttons, and the flyout menu entry.
- **Preferred caption language:** replaces `Caption language`. Settings: RVX → General.
- **DeArrow:** a new RVX → DeArrow screen replaces `Alternative thumbnails` and its DeArrow titles (titles, icon, casual mode, per-screen thumbnails).
- **Restore original titles:** now uses anddea's reworked implementation.
- **Volume boost:** swipe past the maximum volume to go up to 200%. Settings: RVX → Swipe controls.
- **Hide live streams:** hides live-now videos in the feed and search results. Settings: RVX → Feed → Hide feed components.
- **Skip silence:** skips silent pauses in video audio. Settings: RVX → Video.

### YouTube Music
- **Skip silence:** anddea's implementation.

## Notes
- The fork's `Copy text` is kept, because anddea's version does not apply on YouTube 20.05.46. Its settings are unchanged.
- `Hide live streams` hides videos with the LIVE thumbnail badge. Results that only show a LIVE ring on the channel avatar stay visible.
- DeArrow, Preferred caption language and Skip silence need an app restart after changing them.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0)
